jobs.title: Product Manager - Hip
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid or Onsite

We’re seeking a dynamic   Product Manager, Hip Downstream Marketing   to drive strategic initiatives that will shape the future of our  hip surgical approach   portfolio. In this high-impact role, you’ll blend clinical insight with marketing expertise to develop go-to-market strategies, manage cross-functional projects, and bring differentiated value to surgeons and patients alike. If you’re passionate about translating customer needs and market trends into powerful strategies that elevate product performance and strengthen brand presence, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact at Stryker.

What you will do:
- Understand key competitors and their relative strengths/weaknesses
- Understand customer groups, including why customers buy the product or service approach for the product or portfolio
- Understand the different marketing channel strategies and associated business implications
- Track and report results/KPIs to leadership and sales
- Understand key competitors and their relative strengths/weaknesses and maintains networks of people and resources for obtaining competitive information
- Explain different product features to different customers as appropriate to their needs
- Maintain customer engagement and deeply understands customer needs
- Play a role in developing key strategy documents: strategic plan, annual marketing plan, product launch plans, etc.
- Support the creation of Project Charters, CERs, and Business Case Financial Models as applicable
- Understand competitive dynamics in the market
- Understand what customers value and how they perceive different attributes of the product or portfolio
- Articulate why the product or portfolio adds value or solves problems for the customer
- Create marketing strategies to understand, develop, and enhance the relationship between the customer and the product or portfolio
- Propose objectives for generating clinical evidence and evaluates studies
- Tie the business goal of the product or portfolio to the overall goal of Stryker
- Synthesize market trends and make recommendations on areas of strategic focus
- Develop new strategies, sales tools, and communication plans for the product or portfolio
- Apply clinical knowledge in combination with technical knowledge to educate and articulate value
- Work closely with sales training/sales enablement to set the sales training strategy for the product or portfolio
- Responsible for the obsolescence plan
- Provide analytical support to set price
- Articulate desired communications outcomes consistent with marketing strategy to MarComm team
- Establish short-range and long-range improvement goals for the product management team, and under guidance, develop action plans to achieve those goals
- Analyze customer satisfaction to assess trends in customer engagement, and incorporates trends into strategic planning
- Provide marketing intelligence group with key objectives and inputs to drive customer insights

What you need (Required):
- Bachelor’s degree required
- 4+ years of work experience required

Preferred:
- MBA preferred
- 2+ years medical device or marketing experience preferred
- Excellent presentation and interpersonal communications skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects while delivering on established timelines
- Ability to be persuasive in the absence of organizational authority
- Must be able to understand and work within complex interdivisional procedures and policies
- Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word & PowerPoint)

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Healthcare is rapidly evolving through connected technologies, digital health solutions, and data-driven care. As a Senior Product Manager supporting Stryker's Smart Care portfolio, you will help shape the future of connected healthcare by developing strategies that expand the adoption of innovative digital solutions across the Canadian market.
In this role, you'll partner with Medical Leadership, Commercial, Clinical, Engineering, Product Development, and cross-functional teams to define portfolio strategy, launch new technologies, and identify growth opportunities that improve customer experience and business performance. If you're passionate about digital transformation, connected technologies, healthcare innovation, and bringing new products to market, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, EDT Product Manager, Product Lifecycle Management
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Senior Manager, EDT Product Manager, Product Lifecycle Management
This Product Manager, Product Lifecycle Management, owns the end-to-end lifecycle of the PLM product portfolio supporting Research and Development and the broader product innovation ecosystem. This role translates customer needs, business goals, and regulatory expectations into a clear product vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes that advance design control, change management, global product data governance, and digital thread capabilities. The Product Manager will operate with a “mini-CEO” mindset—customer-obsessed, data-driven, and accountable for decisions, trade-offs, value realization, adoption, total cost of ownership, and delivery results.

Key responsibilities include:
- Define and execute the global Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning business objectives, manufacturing requirements, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
- Serve as the Product Owner and subject matter expert for PTC Windchill, driving capabilities across product data management, engineering change management, BOM management, document control, workflows, and lifecycle governance.
- Partner with stakeholders across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Digital Technology to translate business needs into scalable, value-driven PLM solutions.
- Own and prioritize the PLM product backlog, balancing business value, technical feasibility, compliance requirements, and operational priorities to maximize product impact.
- Develop business cases, roadmap recommendations, and delivery plans while driving informed trade-off decisions across scope, timelines, risk, and value realization.
- Establish and maintain governance standards for PLM solution architecture, data quality, configuration management, release management, and platform support in a regulated MedTech environment.
- Ensure PLM capabilities support global compliance requirements, including design controls, quality management, audit readiness, traceability, validation, and regulatory standards.
- Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance business processes, user experience, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and data quality through innovative technology solutions.
- Lead stakeholder engagement, change management, communication, and adoption initiatives to ensure successful delivery and long-term business value from PLM investments.
- Collaborate with external vendors, implementation partners, and cross-functional teams while leveraging industry trends, digital thread capabilities, and ERP integrations to advance PLM strategy and innovation.

What you need:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; certifications in Product Management, Agile, PTC Windchill, SAP, or Quality Systems are highly desirable
- 15 years of experience in enterprise application delivery, product management, platform ownership, or technology leadership, with significant exposure to PLM, R&D, engineering, quality, or regulated product development environments.
- Deep expertise in PTC Windchill and Product Lifecycle Management processes, including product data management, engineering change control, BOM management, workflow, and lifecycle governance.
- Proven experience integrating PLM platforms with ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle EBS, or JDE to support end-to-end product development and manufacturing processes.
- Strong product leadership skills with the ability to define strategy, prioritize roadmaps and backlogs, drive execution, and deliver measurable business value.
- Solid understanding of MedTech/Life Sciences regulations, including design controls, quality systems, validation, traceability, audit readiness, and global compliance requirements.
- Demonstrated success delivering large-scale technology transformations while balancing business outcomes, user experience, technical feasibility, and regulatory compliance.
- Strategic mindset with experience managing vendors and partners, leveraging product analytics, and identifying emerging industry trends to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

Travel Percentage: None

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Owner, Voice Intelligence
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

It's Time to Join Stryker!

Stryker is seeking a Senior Staff Product Owner, Voice Intelligence to help shape the next generation of intelligent caregiver communication experiences within our Smart Care platform.

Voice Intelligence is a strategic investment area focused on making clinical communication more natural, intuitive, and connected. Today, caregivers use voice-enabled Stryker solutions to communicate and coordinate care. We are expanding those capabilities across badges, mobile applications, connected medical devices, and future care-delivery endpoints.

The future extends beyond simple voice commands. Our vision includes intelligent voice workflows, speech recognition, ambient documentation, real-time interpretation, conversational AI, and other AI-enabled services that can work together seamlessly in the clinical environment.

In this role, you will become a trusted product expert for Voice Intelligence. Working within the strategic direction established by Product Management, you will translate customer needs, clinical workflows, and roadmap priorities into valuable, technically feasible solutions for our software development teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership, technical aptitude, customer empathy, analytical thinking, and the ability to lead through influence . You will be expected to think beyond backlog management—taking ownership of the customer experience from concept through delivery, adoption, and measurable impact.

What You Will Do
- Own product definition and execution for Voice Intelligence capabilities across multiple applications, devices, services, and clinical workflows.
- Develop deep expertise in caregiver communication workflows, voice-enabled experiences, speech technologies, conversational AI, and the broader Voice Intelligence ecosystem.
- Translate customer problems, clinical workflows, and product priorities into clear epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and executable development plans.
- Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to refine product concepts, evaluate technical feasibility, and make thoughtful scope and prioritization tradeoffs.
- Maintain a strong working understanding of product architecture, cloud services, integrations, APIs, security considerations, and cross-team dependencies.
- Help create intuitive experiences that allow caregivers to move seamlessly between voice-enabled capabilities such as communication, interpretation, documentation, and future intelligent services.
- Identify and communicate technical risks, dependencies, quality concerns, and delivery impacts early enough to enable effective decision-making.
- Incorporate Voice of Customer insights, user feedback, market context, and product performance into feature definition and prioritization.
- Collaborate directly with customers and clinical users through demonstrations, feedback sessions, workflow discussions, and other discovery activities.
- Partner cross-functionally with R&D, Quality, Clinical, Marketing, Project Management, and other teams to align priorities and drive successful product outcomes.
- Communicate product decisions, progress, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders.
- Support product and business analysis by providing input on scope, sequencing, dependencies, delivery impacts, and customer value.
- Drive strong backlog quality, planning discipline, and predictable execution while ensuring development teams understand the customer problem and intended product outcome.
- Influence across teams and help align capabilities that span multiple products, platforms, and engineering organizations.
- Continuously build expertise in emerging voice, AI, and healthcare technologies and apply that knowledge to future product opportunities.

- 6+ years of experience in software product development, product ownership, product management, software development, or closely related roles is required.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, EDT Product Manager, Global Labeling Solutions
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Senior Manager, EDT Product Manager, Global Labeling Solutions
The Product Manager, Global Labeling Solutions owns the end-to-end lifecycle of the enterprise labeling capabilities that enable compliant, accurate, scalable, reliable, and efficient label design, approval, content management, and printing across global manufacturing and distribution operations. This role translates customer needs, business goals, and regulatory expectations into a clear product vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes that advance design control, change management, global product data governance, and digital thread capabilities. The Product Manager will operate with a “mini-CEO” mindset—customer-obsessed, data-driven, and accountable for decisions, trade-offs, value realization, adoption, total cost of ownership, and delivery results.

What You Will Do
- Define and execute the global product vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise labeling capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives, manufacturing needs, regulatory requirements, and industry trends.
- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and prioritization through delivery, adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement.
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Digital Technology to translate business needs into scalable labeling solutions and measurable outcomes.
- Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, technical feasibility, compliance requirements, and operational priorities while driving informed trade-off decisions.
- Serve as the product owner and subject matter expert for Loftware Cloud and/or Loftware Cloud Clinical Trials, overseeing capabilities including label design, content and template management, workflow automation, print execution, auditability, and validation readiness.
- Lead the design and evolution of integrations between labeling platforms and enterprise systems (ERP, PLM, MES, WMS, clinical supply, and master data systems) to enable accurate, data-driven label generation and printing.
- Establish and maintain governance frameworks for labeling processes, templates, translations, version control, access management, change control, release management, and lifecycle support in a regulated environment.
- Ensure labeling solutions meet global compliance and quality standards, including UDI, MDR, GxP , validation requirements, audit readiness, traceability, and electronic records/signatures regulations.
- Drive stakeholder engagement, change management, training, and adoption initiatives to enable successful deployment and long-term business value realization across global teams.
- Monitor product performance, user feedback, and industry developments to identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, operational efficiency, and enhanced user experience.

What You Need
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred), with 15+ years of experience in product management, platform ownership, or enterprise application delivery within regulated industries.
- Proven expertise with Loftware Cloud, and/or ROBAR , including label design, template and content management, approval workflows, print management, auditability, and validation-ready platform capabilities.
- Strong understanding of enterprise labeling ecosystems and integrations with business-critical platforms such as ERP, PLM, MES, WMS, clinical supply, and master data systems.
- Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps and backlogs, prioritizing investments, and delivering complex technology solutions that balance business value, user experience, technical feasibility, and compliance requirements.
- Deep knowledge of MedTech, life sciences, or other regulated environments, including GxP , UDI, MDR, validation, traceability, audit readiness, and electronic records/signatures requirements.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive change, and achieve alignment across global matrix organizations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, using data, customer insights, and product metrics to inform decisions, measure outcomes, and continuously improve platform adoption and effectiveness.
- Experience managing external vendors, implementation partners, and consultants, coupled with an ownership mindset, customer focus, and passion for driving innovation and operational excellence through enterprise labeling solutions.

Travel Percentage: 10%
